meanings.gloss: asked (someone to do something / for something)

sentences.text: Sie bat mich, ihr zu helfen.
sentences.en: She asked me to help her.

sentences.text: Ich bat ihn, langsam zu sprechen.
sentences.en: I asked him to speak slowly.

sentences.text: Tom bat seinen Vater um Geld.
sentences.en: Tom asked his father for money.

sentences.text: Er bat sie, bei ihm zu bleiben.
sentences.en: He asked her to stay with him.

sentences.text: Norah bat uns, nichts zu sagen.
sentences.en: Norah asked us not to say anything.

sentences.text: Ich bat dich doch, das nicht zu tun!
sentences.en: I asked you not to do that!
sentences.review: A spoken reproach with 'doch' sounds stilted in the simple past; natives would say 'Ich hatte dich doch gebeten, das nicht zu tun!' (or 'Ich habe dich doch gebeten…'). The English could also show the 'doch' nuance, e.g. 'I did ask you not to do that!'
